problem_type: Composer placement must preserve all neighboring node hit regions
symptom: Selected composer intercepts clicks on neighboring image/video nodes in batch production and real process feedback.
direct_cause: Viewport-only placement omits neighboring node rectangles and allows min-height overflow.
class_root: Composer placement layer does not own collision-free geometry for all visible obstacles.
affected_population: Selected generated nodes with timeline preview or other bottom docks
internal_only_reason: This extends the existing internal overlay-avoidance invariant as explicitly requested; no new framework or external protocol.
invariants: Composer stays inside stage, outside all other media nodes, fixed docks, toolbars and connection hit regions; constrained content scrolls.
generality_proof: All model and media kinds share one DOM measurement and rectangle placement owner; no provider-specific cases.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Measure all workspace bottom docks and recompute on membership/size changes.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both expanded and collapsed preview expose data-canvas-bottom-dock.
Batch dock exposes the same marker.
Both use useComposerViewportPlacement, and neighboring article[data-node-id] rects are measured in screen coordinates.

recurrence.reason: CI image-to-image and local image-to-video clicks reproduce the same obstruction.
same_class_scan: Read TimelineMiniPreview.tsx and CanvasBatchGenerateDock.tsx; both use data-canvas-bottom-dock.
Read useComposerViewportPlacement; only timeline handle was measured and observed.
Read NodeGenerationComposer and BaseGenerationNode; all media composers share the hook and article marker.
Side placement also intersects the existing magnetic handle hit spans; read their DOM rectangles without editing reactFlow kernel.
Scanned src and tests for the old hook, event constant, event string and exported helpers; no remaining references after deletion.

prevention.invariant: Composer stays inside stage, outside all other media nodes, fixed docks, toolbars and connection hit regions; constrained content scrolls.
prevention.failure_mode: Constrain and scroll within free space, using the selected media interior only when external attachments cannot fit; other node rectangles remain hard obstacles.
prevention.strategy: Subtract measured obstacles from four attachment regions; replace forced viewport pan and colliding minimum height with panel-only placement and scrolling.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed viewport-only flip/pan/minimum-height path; one obstacle-aware placement algorithm owns all forms. Deleted the obsolete pan hook, its tests, React Flow wiring and event constant; removed stale comments. customEventWiring.test.ts enforces absence of orphan event listeners.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Screen-space DOM geometry and existing CSS only; no dependency or external API change.

residual_risks: Linux CI verification remains necessary after local macOS full shards.

invariant_owner_layer.note: composer 放置层，统一屏幕矩形测量和无碰撞裁决。
